# Reduction: var s float32; for i := range a { s += a[i] } accumulates in a vector
# and adds ReduceSum to s once at the end, so a nonzero starting value is kept.
# ReduceSum is only in go1.28-devel.

exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want

env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func SumFloat32s(a []float32) float32 {
	var s float32
	for i := range a {
		s += a[i]
	}
	return s
}

func SumFromFloat32s(s float32, a []float32) float32 {
	for i := range a {
		s += a[i]
	}
	return s
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import "simd"

func SumFloat32s(a []float32) float32 {
	var s float32
	var _vacc simd.Float32s
	for _i := 0; _i < len(a); {
		_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(a[_i:])
		_vacc = _vacc.Add(_v1)
		_i += _n
	}
	s += _vacc.ReduceSum()
	return s
}

func SumFromFloat32s(s float32, a []float32) float32 {
	var _vacc simd.Float32s
	for _i := 0; _i < len(a); {
		_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(a[_i:])
		_vacc = _vacc.Add(_v1)
		_i += _n
	}
	s += _vacc.ReduceSum()
	return s
}
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 2 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
-- testmain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/test"
)

func main() {
	a := make([]float32, 37)
	for i := range a {
		a[i] = float32(i + 1)
	}
	fmt.Println(test.SumFloat32s(a), test.SumFloat32s(nil), test.SumFromFloat32s(100, a), test.SumFloat32s(a[:5]))
}
-- testmain/output --
703 0 803 15
